empty_gt.rule: GT has no letters and no digits after removing whitespace, punctuation and format characters.

repeated_gt.rule: Spaces removed, some span of >= 15 characters appears again within 12 characters of its end (the GT, or part of it, was pasted twice). Also fires when the GT is a whole-line repeat X+X.
repeated_gt.fix: Confirm with a reader (reader tier: doubled_gt); then cut the copy.

char_run.rule: The same non-space, non-tatweel character repeated >= 6 times in a row.
char_run.fix: Look: usually a keyboard or HTR artefact.

off_script.rule: Fewer than 50 % of the GT's letters are Arabic-script letters (GT >= 5 letters).
off_script.fix: Look: wrong language, transliteration or encoding error.

degenerate.fix: Re-cut from the page if a polygon exists, else drop.

vertical.rule: Image height >= 1.8 x width: a vertical or marginal strip, not a horizontal line (skipped when the GT has <= 2 letters, which can be narrow legitimately).
vertical.fix: Drop, or rotate if the text runs vertically.

blank.rule: No ink: the image is one flat colour (grey std < 2), or < 0.3 % of its non-padding pixels are darker than 0.8 x the local paper brightness (max filter over 1/8-scale neighbourhoods, so vignetting, ruling and coloured ink do not matter) while the GT has >= 3 letters. Deliberately conservative: faint but present text passes and is left to the reader tier.

multi_line.rule: After deskewing (+-8 deg), the horizontal ink projection (smoothed over H/15 rows, padding excluded) has >= 2 prominent peaks: each >= 45 % of the highest with >= 40 % of the main line's ink mass (summed over one core height), apart by >= max(15 % of the height, 0.8 x the main line's core height), with a valley between them <= 50 % of the lower peak, and the extra peak >= 12 % of the height from the top and bottom edge (a whole extra line, not a clipped one: see neighbour_clip). Ascender tips and descender loops clipped from neighbour lines are too low to count.
multi_line.fix: Re-cut to the line polygon; if the GT holds only one line, the extra line is noise.

neighbour_clip.rule: Like multi_line, but the extra peak lies within 12 % of the top or bottom edge: a neighbour line cut in half by the crop. Informational: common in polygon-bounding-box crops.
neighbour_clip.fix: Usually keep; re-cut to the polygon if the reader is confused by it.

length_mismatch.rule: Robust z-score (median / MAD over the dataset) of log(GT letters) - log(core width / core height), where the core is the main line's band on the deskewed ink (neighbour fragments excluded), is beyond +-3.5: far too many letters for the ink (GT longer than the image: cut crop, doubled GT, wrong line) or far too few (truncated GT, extra ink).
length_mismatch.fix: Look; the sign says which way.

gt_truncated.rule: The reader reads all of the GT and much more: sub + del <= 15 % of GT length and insertions >= 15 % of GT length + 5.

image_truncated.rule: The GT holds all the reader reads and much more: sub + ins <= 15 % of GT length and deletions >= 30 % of GT length + 5 (the crop misses part of the line, or the GT holds extra text).
image_truncated.fix: Re-cut from the page, or drop.

doubled_gt.rule: Spaces removed, the longest span of >= 5 characters that repeats within 12 characters of its end is a paste: deleting its second copy from the GT cuts the edit distance to the reading by >= 60 % of the span length. Natural repeats (“الاثنين في الاثنين”) are read twice and gain nothing.
doubled_gt.fix: Cut the copy from the GT.

shifted.rule: CER(GT, own reading) >= 30 %, GT >= 15 characters, and the reading of another line on the same page matches the GT with CER < min(30 %, half the own CER): the GT belongs to a neighbour.
shifted.fix: Re-assign GTs along the page (or drop).

unreadable.rule: CER(GT, reading) >= 60 % with GT >= 10 characters and no more specific flag.
unreadable.fix: Look: garbled GT, wrong crop, or a hard line.

duplicate_image.rule: Two or more lines have the same image (hash of the 64 x 16 greyscale thumbnail); detail says whether their GTs agree and whether they cross splits (leakage).
duplicate_image.fix: Keep one; if the GTs differ, one is wrong.

duplicate_gt.rule: Two or more lines share an identical GT of >= 25 characters.
duplicate_gt.fix: Look: repeated content, or the same GT pasted on different images.
